meta.note: Veterinary-only medicines have no FDA human drug label. General plain-language summaries drafted with AI from manufacturer and FDA Center for Veterinary Medicine information, for education only. Not veterinary advice.

drugs.for: Relieves pain and inflammation in dogs, often from arthritis or after surgery.
watch: Vomiting, diarrhea, black or tarry stool, or not eating
Can affect the liver and kidneys; vets often check bloodwork
Don't combine with other NSAIDs, steroids or human pain relievers unless your vet says so
ask: Does my dog need bloodwork while taking this, and how often?

drugs.for: Controls itching from allergies and allergic skin disease in dogs.
watch: Not for dogs under 12 months old or with serious infections
Watch for new lumps, infections, vomiting or diarrhea
ask: Is long-term use right for my dog, and how will we check on it?

drugs.for: Helps the heart pump more strongly in dogs with certain kinds of heart disease or heart failure.
watch: Usually given about an hour before a meal
Report loss of appetite, coughing, fainting or faster breathing at rest
ask: What resting breathing rate should we watch for at home?

drugs.for: Controls pain and inflammation from osteoarthritis in dogs.
watch: Don't combine with NSAIDs or steroids unless your vet says so
ask: Can this be used with my dog's other pain medicines?
